mission_08: Building a production-ready imputation pipeline requires combining multiple strategies into a single, reproducible workflow. Different column types demand different imputation approaches: numeric columns benefit from MICE or KNN imputation, while categorical columns use mode imputation. After imputation, numeric features typically need scaling for downstream modeling. sklearn Pipeline and ColumnTransformer make it possible to chain these operations cleanly, ensuring that the same transformations are applied consistently to training and test data. This approach prevents data leakage, ensures reproducibility, and makes the entire preprocessing workflow portable. A well-designed imputation pipeline is essential for any real-world machine learning system where missing data is the norm rather than the exception.
